questions.question: After interchanging the given two signs, what will be the value of the given equation? × and ÷ 47 + 13 ÷ 95 × 5 – 16
questions.questionHtml:
After interchanging the given two signs, what will be the value of the given equation?
× and ÷

47 + 13 ÷ 95 × 5 – 16
questions.solution:
After interchanging × and ÷, the new equation becomes:
47 + 13 × 95 ÷ 5 – 16

Now solve step-by-step:
= 47 + (13 × 95 ÷ 5) – 16
= 47 + (13 × 19) – 16
= 47 + 247 – 16
= 278

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘GIRL’ is coded as ‘XZIC’. What is the code for ‘BOYS’ in that code language?
questions.questionHtml: In a certain code language, ‘GIRL’ is coded as ‘XZIC’. What is the code for ‘BOYS’ in that code language?
questions.solution:
Explanation:

Given: ‘GIRL’ → ‘XZIC’
Logic: Each letter is moved +17 forward in the alphabet.

Now apply the same rule to BOYS –

B → S
O → F
Y → P
S → J

So, BOYS → SFPJ

questions.question: 126 is related to 18 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 147 is related to 21. To which of the following is 189 related following the same logic? (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.questionHtml:
126 is related to 18 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 147 is related to 21. To which of the following is 189 related following the same logic?
(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
Logic: The number is divided by 7.
126 ÷ 7 = 18
147 ÷ 7 = 21
So, 189 ÷ 7 = 27

Hence, 189 is related to 27.
